subject: general
question: The average of 6 values is 11.2. If 3 is multiplied to each number then what will be the new average?
solution:
**Given:**

Average of 6 values = 11.2

Each number is multiplied by 3

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of values/number of values

**Concept Used:**

If each number is multiplied by same factor then average of the whole group containing these numbers is also multiplied by the same factor.

**Calculation:**

The new average = 3 × old average 

⇒ 3 × 11.2

⇒ 33.6

**∴ If 3 is multiplied to each number then the new average will be 33.6**
